items.item_text: Current, valid California RN license, required
BLS from the American Red Cross or American Heart Association required
Official Transcripts and/or original diploma from a registered nursing program must be provided upon hire
6 months of Med Surg RN experience, required; 2 years, preferred

As a valued member of our world-renowned health system, you'll help advance our commitment to exceptional patient care and support our Magnet® designated nursing excellence. Here, you'll find the opportunity to grow your expertise, elevate your career, and make a meaningful impact every day while continuing to Keep On Rising.

In this exciting and rewarding position, you will provide exceptional nursing care for AMN Med Surg patients. You will offer guidance to team members by supervising nursing interventions and assigning related tasks. You will also assess patient, family and staff learning needs, deliver appropriate clinical education and promote effective working relationships. This involves collaborating with an interdisciplinary team of dedicated professionals to develop and implement a care plan, including providing detailed care instructions.

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
Skill in implementing appropriate nursing interventions on a consistent basis
Ability to perform historical, physical and behavioral patient assessments
Ability to develop and implement and evaluate patient care plan actively involving patients, family, and staff
